rules.text: Respect the host project's existing design, chart and motion owners before adding a new one.
Use the minimum number of libraries needed for explicit task capabilities.
Give each major UI role one explicit owner.
Prefer HostProfile and TaskProfile evidence; use task text only as a backward-compatible inference path.
Reject candidates whose declared framework support excludes the host framework.
Prefer existing CSS or component-native motion before adding a timeline engine.
Use Rive only for meaningful interactive vector graphics with confirmed asset rights.
Never vendor or redistribute React Bits component source from OrchestrUI.
Never silently use paid or authenticated material.
Accessibility, responsiveness, performance and coherence outrank novelty.
An occupied exclusive role rejects a second owner unless an isolation strategy exists outside this recommendation.

base-system.description: Semantic controls, themes and application primitives.

product-polish.description: Selective product surfaces compatible with the host base.

data-visualization.description: Charts, gauges, heatmaps and analytical graphics.

timeline-motion.description: Bespoke timeline, SVG or scroll choreography.

requirements.reason: Rive asset rights must be confirmed for the exact .riv asset.

host_conflicts.reason: The host base system already owns semantic controls and themes.
Kokonut is a shadcn-compatible layer and is not added on top of a daisyUI base without an isolation plan.

selected_conflicts.reason: daisyUI and Kokonut cannot both own component foundations in one unisolated plan.
